quotas.name: Single-Region clusters

quotas.description: The maximum number of DataSync tasks that you can create in a specific AWS account and AWS Region.

quotas.name: Maximum number of (Enhanced mode tasks) source and destination objects that DataSync can work with per task execution
quotas.description: The maximum number of source and destination objects that DataSync can work with per task execution in Enhanced mode. This quota is virtually unlimited.

quotas.name: Maximum number of (Basic mode tasks) source and destination files, objects, and directories that DataSync can work with per task execution between self-managed storage or other clouds and AWS services
quotas.description: The maximum number of source and destination files, objects, and directories that DataSync can work with per task execution in Basic mode between self-managed storage or other clouds and AWS services.
